app.go:13:28: tako.CronMissed watches a cron that runs every 168h, and absence over that long cannot be expressed — Cloud Monitoring refuses a lookback past 25h on a custom metric, and any window it accepts is shorter than this cron's own interval, so the alert would fire between healthy runs. Run the cron at least daily and watch that, or check freshness inside a daily cron that can fail (tako/window)
